title.en: A local workbench for multi-agent coding workflows
title.zh: 在本機編排多個 coding agent 的工作台

description.en: Runs Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, and OpenRouter models through headless runtimes in staged workflows, with orchestrator gates, git worktree isolation, your own verification command, and a replayable event log.
description.zh: 用分階段的工作流，透過 headless runtime 執行 Claude Code、Codex、Grok、Antigravity 與 OpenRouter 模型，並提供協調者關卡、git worktree 隔離、自訂的驗證指令，以及可以回放的事件紀錄。

eyebrow.zh: 多 agent 工作台 · 桌面版與網頁版

headline.en: Stage your coding agents. Gate every handoff.
headline.zh: 讓 agent 接力，交接都要過關。

lede.en: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, and Antigravity run through their own headless runtimes, and OpenRouter models run through Codex. An orchestrator agent gates each stage, your test command can check each patch, and the whole run stays replayable.
lede.zh: Claude Code、Codex、Grok、Antigravity 都透過各自的 headless runtime 執行，OpenRouter 的模型則借用 Codex 執行。每個階段由協調者 agent 把關，patch 可以交給你自己的測試指令檢查，整個執行過程都能回放。

meta.en: Pipeline preset · verify command: npm test
meta.zh: 內建 Pipeline 流程 · 驗證指令：npm test

label.zh: 最新版本，2026 年 7 月
個 provider，另有測試用 mock
每個階段最多的 agent 數

title.en: Side-by-side answers are not a workflow.
title.zh: 並排的答案，還不是工作流程。

body.en: Its predecessor, multi-ai-chat-desktop, orchestrated web chats. That is fine for comparing answers, but a chat window cannot edit your repository, run your tests, or record who decided what. Multi-AI Terminal (MAT) drives each agent's headless runtime inside your workspace, so every edit, check, and decision is kept as data.
body.zh: 前一代的 multi-ai-chat-desktop 串的是網頁聊天。拿來比較答案沒問題，但聊天視窗改不了你的 repo、跑不了你的測試，也記不下誰做了什麼決定。Multi-AI Terminal（MAT）直接驅動各家 agent 的 headless runtime，在你的工作區裡動手，每一次修改、檢查與決策都會存成資料。

quote.en: A degraded or unverified advance is labeled, never hidden.
quote.zh: 降級放行或未經驗證的結果，都會清楚標示，絕不藏起來。

title.zh: 組流程、跑 agent、過關卡、留紀錄。

intro.en: A run applies a workflow to a workspace: ordered stages, each holding one or more agent slots, with an optional gate after each stage.
intro.zh: 一次執行，就是把一個工作流套用到一個工作區：依序排好的階段，每個階段放一個以上的 agent 槽位，階段結束後可以設一道關卡。

body.en: Point MAT at a project directory by absolute path, or pick it with Browse in the desktop app. Optionally set a verification command such as npm test.
body.zh: 用絕對路徑指定專案目錄，桌面版也可以用 Browse 選資料夾。可以順便設定驗證指令，例如 npm test。

body.en: Start from Planning, Build, Review, or Pipeline. Under Customize, each slot sets provider, model, reasoning effort, permission tier, prompt template, and count.
body.zh: 從規劃、建置、審查或 Pipeline 四個內建流程開始。在「進階設定」裡，每個槽位可以指定 provider、模型、推理強度、權限層級、提示範本與數量。

body.en: A stage's agents run in parallel, each optionally in its own git worktree. At a gated stage, an orchestrator agent reads a digest of the candidates and answers advance, retry, or abort in strict JSON.
body.zh: 同一階段的 agent 平行執行，也可以各自在獨立的 git worktree 裡動手。遇到有關卡的階段，協調者 agent 會讀取候選結果的摘要，用嚴格的 JSON 回覆繼續、重試或中止。

body.en: Conversation lists each answer, decision, check, and failure. Timeline replays the raw event log. Export a Markdown report or a debug bundle when you hand the work on.
body.zh: 「對話」列出每個回答、決策、檢查與失敗，「時間軸」回放原始事件紀錄。要交接時，可以匯出 Markdown 報告或除錯套件。

intro.en: MAT treats agent output as evidence to check, not as an answer to trust.
intro.zh: MAT 把 agent 的輸出當成要查核的證據，而不是直接採信的答案。

body.en: Claude runs through the Agent SDK and Codex through a persistent codex app-server. Grok and Antigravity run as headless CLIs behind FIFO managers, and OpenRouter models run through Codex with an isolated config.
body.zh: Claude 透過 Agent SDK 執行，Codex 透過常駐的 codex app-server。Grok 與 Antigravity 以 headless CLI 執行，各自前面有一個 FIFO manager 負責排隊；OpenRouter 的模型則借用 Codex 執行，並使用獨立的設定。

body.en: Any provider can orchestrate. A retry can target specific nodes and add a prompt addendum. If the answer cannot be parsed or the retry budget runs out (2 per stage by default), the stage advances and is marked degraded.
body.zh: 任何 provider 都能擔任協調者。重試可以只針對特定節點，並附上補充提示。回覆無法解析，或用完重試額度（預設每階段 2 次）時，階段會繼續往下，並標為降級。

body.en: Nodes can run in their own git worktree, and each attempt is captured as a binary patch. Apply one from the UI: MAT checks it with git apply first and lists conflicts instead of forcing it.
body.zh: 節點可以在獨立的 git worktree 裡執行，每次嘗試的修改都存成二進位 patch。從介面套用時，MAT 會先用 git apply 檢查，有衝突就列出來，不會硬套。

body.en: Each workspace can set a command such as npm test, with a 600-second default timeout. Worktree candidates with a non-empty patch run it, and a stage with requireVerified retries failed checks when nothing passed.
body.zh: 每個工作區可以設定一個驗證指令，例如 npm test，預設逾時 600 秒。若候選結果使用 worktree 且 patch 不是空的，就會執行這個指令；開啟 requireVerified 的階段，如果沒有任何候選通過，就會重試沒過的那些。

body.en: Interrupt stops the active candidates, keeps their partial logs and patches, and runs your instruction. Queue waits for the next stage boundary. Up to 8 per run, first in, first out, never typed into a running process.
body.zh: 「立即插入」會停下正在執行的候選，保留已產生的日誌與 patch，再執行你的新指示；「排隊」則等到下一個階段交界。每次執行最多 8 則，先進先出，絕不會寫進執行中行程的 stdin。

body.en: The Markdown report separates generated, reviewed, advanced, and verified work, with CLI versions, usage, patches, and checks. The debug bundle is one zip of the whole run, with environment variable values redacted.
body.zh: Markdown 報告會分開標示已產生、已審查、已放行與已驗證的工作，並附上 CLI 版本、用量、patch 與驗證結果。除錯套件把整次執行打包成一個 zip，環境變數的值都會遮蔽。

title.zh: 一個本機伺服器，多種 runtime。

intro.en: The browser UI and the desktop shell talk to the same Node server. It owns runs, gates, and storage, and starts and stops each provider's runtime as a child process or SDK session.
intro.zh: 瀏覽器介面和桌面版都連到同一個 Node 伺服器。執行、關卡與儲存都由它負責，各家 provider 的 runtime 也由它以子行程或 SDK session 的形式啟動與停止。

label.zh: REST + WebSocket → 引擎 → agent → 磁碟

return.en: Data lives in ~/.multi-ai-terminal. The Tauri 2 desktop app runs the same server on a random loopback port.
return.zh: 資料放在 ~/.multi-ai-terminal。Tauri 2 桌面版跑的是同一個伺服器，只是改用隨機的 loopback 連接埠。

items.en: Binds 127.0.0.1; set a token before switching the host to 0.0.0.0
items.zh: 預設綁定 127.0.0.1；改用 0.0.0.0 之前，先設定 token

items.en: Agents start from argv arrays; only your verification command runs in a shell
items.zh: agent 一律以參數陣列啟動，只有你設定的驗證指令會經過 shell

items.en: Managed runtimes are pinned, integrity-checked, and kept under the data directory
items.zh: 代管的 runtime 鎖定版本並驗證完整性，只裝在資料目錄內

items.en: No global @latest installs and no edits to the host PATH
items.zh: 不在全域安裝 @latest，也不修改主機的 PATH

items.en: Environment variable values are redacted before anything is written to disk
items.zh: 寫進磁碟之前，環境變數的值都會先遮蔽

title.zh: 用 headless runtime，不用網頁聊天

body.en: Driving each vendor's CLI, app-server, or SDK gives MAT tool events, usage, patches, and exit codes it can normalize into one schema. The cost: every provider needs its own install and sign-in, and the Grok and agy streams carry less detail.
body.zh: 直接驅動各家的 CLI、app-server 或 SDK，MAT 才拿得到工具事件、用量、patch 與結束代碼，並整理成同一套格式。代價是每個 provider 都得各自安裝、登入，而 Grok 與 agy 的串流細節也比較少。

title.zh: 寧可降級放行，也不卡住

body.en: If the orchestrator's answer cannot be parsed, or a stage spends its retry budget, the run moves on and the decision is marked degraded in the UI and the report. A run that finishes with a visible caveat beats one that never finishes.
body.zh: 協調者的回覆無法解析，或某個階段用完重試額度時，執行會繼續往下，這個決策會在介面與報告裡標為降級。帶著明確註記跑完，總比永遠跑不完好。

title.zh: 同一家 provider 錯開啟動

body.en: Parallel Codex sessions on one OAuth login can race the single-use refresh token. MAT starts sessions of the same provider at least 1.5 seconds apart, orchestrator included. That narrows the race without removing it, so API keys or serial use stay the durable fix.
body.zh: 同一個 OAuth 登入下平行跑多個 Codex session，可能會搶著輪替只能用一次的 refresh token。MAT 讓同一家 provider 的啟動至少間隔 1.5 秒，協調者也算在內。這只能減少互搶，無法根除，長久的解法還是改用 API key 或依序使用。

title.zh: runtime 處理跟著 BAT 走

body.en: Provider sessions follow Better Agent Terminal: a persistent codex app-server controller and Claude Agent SDK sessions. MAT is not a fork. It ports that pattern to a Node-only server and applies it to grok and agy as well.
body.zh: provider session 的處理方式參考 Better Agent Terminal：常駐的 codex app-server controller，加上 Claude Agent SDK session。MAT 不是 fork，而是把這套做法移植到純 Node 的伺服器，也套用到 grok 與 agy。

intro.en: Both need Node.js 20 or newer, Git (2.32+ recommended), and sign-in or an API key for each provider you use. Claude and Codex can use runtimes MAT downloads for you; Grok needs grok, Antigravity needs agy, and OpenRouter needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
intro.zh: 兩種方式都需要 Node.js 20 以上、Git（建議 2.32 以上），以及你要用的每家 provider 的登入或 API key。Claude 與 Codex 可以使用 MAT 代為下載的 runtime；Grok 需要 grok，Antigravity 需要 agy，OpenRouter 則需要 OPENROUTER_API_KEY。

body.en: Windows: the setup .exe or the .msi. macOS: the .dmg for Apple silicon or Intel; it is not signed or notarized, so allow the first launch under System Settings, Privacy & Security. Linux: .deb, .AppImage, or .rpm.
body.zh: Windows 用 setup .exe 或 .msi。macOS 依晶片選 Apple silicon 或 Intel 的 .dmg；它沒有簽章也沒有經過公證，第一次開啟要到「系統設定」的「隱私權與安全性」允許。Linux 可選 .deb、.AppImage 或 .rpm。

body.en: Clone the repository, then build and start it. The UI and API come up on http://127.0.0.1:7788. Port, host, data directory, and token can each be set with a flag or an environment variable.
body.zh: 先 clone 這個 repo，再建置並啟動。網頁介面與 API 會開在 http://127.0.0.1:7788。連接埠、位址、資料目錄與 token 都可以用參數或環境變數設定。

steps.code:
npm install
npm run build
npm start

body.en: In Projects, add a workspace. Back in Launch, pick Planning, Build, Review, or Pipeline, describe the task, and press Start. Open Customize only to change stages or agents.
body.zh: 在「專案」加入工作區，回到「啟動」選規劃、建置、審查或 Pipeline，寫下任務後按「開始執行」。要改階段或 agent 時，才需要打開「進階設定」。

intro.en: Built in six days: 21 releases, from v0.1.0 on July 18, 2026 to v0.2.10 on July 23. No feature changes since. An October 2026 cleanup removed personal notes, fixed the docs, and updated dependencies to close every open Dependabot alert; those updates are on main and not yet in a release.
intro.zh: 六天內做出來：從 2026 年 7 月 18 日的 v0.1.0 到 7 月 23 日的 v0.2.10，共 21 個版本。之後沒有新功能。2026 年 10 月整理過一次，移除個人筆記、修正文件，並更新相依套件，關掉所有未處理的 Dependabot 警示；這些更新目前只在 main 上，還沒有包進新版本。

works.en: Desktop installers for Windows, macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), and Linux (.deb, .AppImage, .rpm)
works.zh: Windows、macOS（Apple silicon 與 Intel）、Linux（.deb、.AppImage、.rpm）都有桌面版安裝檔

works.en: Five providers (claude, codex, grok, agy, openrouter) plus a deterministic mock for tests
works.zh: 五個 provider（claude、codex、grok、agy、openrouter），另有測試用、結果固定的 mock

works.en: Custom stages, worktree isolation, patch apply, verification, steering, reports, and debug bundles
works.zh: 自訂階段、worktree 隔離、套用 patch、驗證、追加指示、報告與除錯套件

works.en: AI-Sister, Midnight, and Daylight themes, in English or Traditional Chinese
works.zh: AI-Sister 紀念版、午夜深色、日光淺色三種主題，介面可切換英文或繁體中文

works.en: CI passed on Ubuntu and Windows for the release commit: npm test (620 passing on Ubuntu), agent-lane tests, typecheck, a browser smoke test, and 5 evidence scenarios on Linux
works.zh: release 的 commit 在 Ubuntu 與 Windows 的 CI 都通過：npm test（Ubuntu 上 620 項通過）、agent 通道測試、型別檢查、瀏覽器冒煙測試，Linux 另外跑 5 個證據情境

limits.en: Grok's stream has no tool events, so grok nodes show thinking and text only
limits.zh: Grok 的串流沒有工具事件，grok 節點只看得到思考與文字

limits.en: agy has no JSON mode or session resume: its stream is plain text, and as orchestrator it is re-briefed at every gate
limits.zh: agy 沒有 JSON 模式，也不能接續 session：串流只有純文字，擔任協調者時每道關卡都要重新交代背景

limits.en: Desktop builds are not code-signed or notarized, and still need Node.js 20+ on PATH (or MAT_NODE)
limits.zh: 桌面版沒有程式碼簽章，也沒有經過 Apple 公證，而且 PATH 上仍需要 Node.js 20 以上（或設定 MAT_NODE）

limits.en: CI and the evidence suite use the mock provider; runs with real signed-in Codex, Claude, or OpenRouter accounts are not part of CI
limits.zh: CI 與證據測試用的是 mock provider，實際登入 Codex、Claude 或 OpenRouter 帳號的執行不在 CI 範圍內

limits.en: Parallel sessions on one Codex OAuth login can still race refresh-token rotation; API keys or serial use avoid it
limits.zh: 同一個 Codex OAuth 登入下的平行 session，仍可能搶著輪替 refresh token；改用 API key 或依序使用就能避開

limits.en: Do not run a source build while the desktop app is open: both use the same data directory and race its stores
limits.zh: 桌面版開著時，不要再從原始碼啟動一份：兩者共用同一個資料目錄，會互相搶寫

limits.en: After a reboot, crash recovery kills stale process groups by saved PID and accepts the risk of PID reuse
limits.zh: 機器重開後，崩潰復原會依記錄的 PID 結束殘留的行程群組，並接受 PID 被重複使用的風險

intro.en: Agents in a stage run in parallel. A gated stage asks the orchestrator for one fenced JSON block.
intro.zh: 同一階段的 agent 平行執行。有關卡的階段會要求協調者給出一個圍起來的 JSON。

note.en: Slots run in parallel, at most 12 agents in the stage, and the same provider starts at least 1.5 seconds apart.
note.zh: 槽位平行執行，一個階段最多 12 個 agent，同一家 provider 至少間隔 1.5 秒才啟動。

note.en: Each attempt keeps the answer and, when isolation is worktree, a binary patch.
note.zh: 每次嘗試留下回答；隔離設成 worktree 時，還會留下二進位 patch。

note.en: The orchestrator answers advance, retry, or abort in one fenced JSON block.
note.zh: 協調者在一個圍起來的 JSON 裡回答 advance、retry 或 abort。

caption.en: A stage runs its agent slots in parallel, with at most 12 agents, and waits at least 1.5 seconds between launches of the same provider, orchestrator included. Each attempt keeps its text. A worktree stage also stores a binary patch. At a gated stage the orchestrator reads a digest and must answer advance, retry, or abort in one fenced JSON block.
caption.zh: 一個階段平行跑槽位裡的 agent，最多 12 個，同一家 provider 的啟動至少間隔 1.5 秒，協調者也算在內。每次嘗試留下文字。設成 worktree 的階段還會存二進位 patch。有關卡時，協調者讀取摘要，並必須在一個圍起來的 JSON 裡回答 advance、retry 或 abort。

intro.en: Environment values are redacted before they are written. The debug bundle is one zip of the run.
intro.zh: 寫入前會遮蔽環境變數的值。除錯套件是整次執行的一個 zip。

note.en: The stage engine appends events as the run moves.
note.zh: 階段引擎隨著執行推進，把事件追加進去。

note.en: The web UI and the desktop app share one data directory.
note.zh: 網頁介面與桌面版共用同一個資料目錄。

note.en: Each attempt's binary patch is kept with the run.
note.zh: 每次嘗試的二進位 patch 跟這次執行放在一起。

note.en: The Markdown report separates generated, reviewed, advanced, and verified work, and the zip redacts environment values.
note.zh: Markdown 報告分開已產生、已審查、已放行與已驗證的工作，zip 會遮蔽環境變數的值。

caption.en: The engine writes the run under the shared data directory used by both the web UI and the desktop app. events.jsonl is the replay log, each attempt can keep a binary patch, and the Markdown report separates generated, reviewed, advanced, and verified work. Environment variable values are redacted before they are written, including inside the debug zip.
caption.zh: 引擎把這次執行寫進網頁介面與桌面版共用的資料目錄。events.jsonl 是回放用的紀錄，每次嘗試可以留下二進位 patch，Markdown 報告則分開已產生、已審查、已放行與已驗證的工作。環境變數的值在寫入前會遮蔽，除錯 zip 裡也一樣。

intro.en: OpenRouter models run through Codex with an isolated config. The mock provider exists for tests.
intro.zh: OpenRouter 的模型透過 Codex 跑，並使用獨立設定。mock provider 是給測試用的。

note.en: The slot names a provider, a model, an effort, and a permission of safe, auto, or full.
note.zh: 槽位指定 provider、模型、推理強度，以及 safe、auto 或 full 的權限。

note.en: Claude uses the Agent SDK, Codex a persistent app-server, and grok and agy are headless CLIs behind a FIFO manager.
note.zh: Claude 用 Agent SDK，Codex 用常駐的 app-server，grok 與 agy 是 FIFO manager 後面的 headless CLI。

caption.en: A slot binds one of claude, codex, grok, agy, or openrouter, plus a permission of safe, auto, or full. Claude runs through the Agent SDK, Codex through a persistent app-server, and grok and agy through headless CLIs coordinated by a FIFO manager. OpenRouter models run through Codex with an isolated config. The mock provider is deterministic and used by tests.
caption.zh: 一個槽位綁定 claude、codex、grok、agy 或 openrouter 之一，再加上 safe、auto 或 full 的權限。Claude 走 Agent SDK，Codex 走常駐的 app-server，grok 與 agy 走由 FIFO manager 協調的 headless CLI。OpenRouter 的模型透過 Codex 執行，並使用獨立設定。mock provider 結果固定，給測試用。

intro.en: Verification runs only for a worktree candidate whose patch is not empty.
intro.zh: 只有使用 worktree、而且 patch 不是空的候選結果，才會跑驗證。

note.en: An empty patch skips the command.
note.zh: 空的 patch 會跳過指令。

note.en: The workspace command, such as npm test, times out at 600 seconds unless you set another limit.
note.zh: 工作區的指令，例如 npm test，除非你另設上限，否則 600 秒逾時。

note.en: Passed, failed, error, or skipped is stored with the log, and requireVerified retries when nothing passed.
note.zh: 通過、失敗、錯誤或略過會連同日誌存下，requireVerified 在沒有人通過時會重試。

caption.en: When a workspace has a verification command, MAT runs it on a worktree candidate with a non empty patch. The default timeout is 600 seconds. The result is passed, failed, error, or skipped, stored with the log. If the stage has requireVerified and no candidate passed, failing candidates are retried within the stage retry budget.
caption.zh: 工作區有驗證指令時，MAT 會對使用 worktree 且 patch 不是空的候選結果執行它。預設逾時 600 秒。結果是通過、失敗、錯誤或略過，並連同日誌存下。階段開了 requireVerified 且沒有人通過時，會在該階段的重試額度內重試沒過的候選。

intro.en: The server binds to loopback unless you change the host. Agent processes start from argument arrays.
intro.zh: 除非你改位址，伺服器只綁定本機迴圈。agent 行程以參數陣列啟動。

note.en: A source run listens on loopback port 7788, and the desktop app picks a free loopback port.
note.zh: 從原始碼啟動時聽本機迴圈連接埠 7788，桌面版改挑一個空的本機迴圈連接埠。

note.en: Binding every interface does not require a token, so anyone who can reach the port can run agents in the workspace.
note.zh: 綁到所有介面時不會強制要 token，連得到該連接埠的人就能在工作區裡跑 agent。

caption.en: By default the server binds to loopback, port 7788 from source and a random loopback port in the desktop app. If you bind a wider host, MAT does not require a token. Set one yourself: REST uses a bearer token and WebSocket a query token. Agents start from argument arrays. Only the verification command runs in a shell.
caption.zh: 伺服器預設綁定本機迴圈：原始碼是連接埠 7788，桌面版是隨機的本機迴圈連接埠。若改綁更寬的位址，MAT 不會強制 token。要自己設定：REST 用 bearer token，WebSocket 用 query token。agent 以參數陣列啟動。只有驗證指令會經過 shell。

intro.en: The default budget is 2 retries per stage. A spent budget advances the stage and marks it degraded.
intro.zh: 預設每個階段可重試 2 次。額度用完會繼續往下，並標成降級。

note.en: Candidates finish with text, and maybe a patch and a verification result.
note.zh: 候選結果結束時帶有文字，也可能帶有 patch 與驗證結果。

note.en: An unparsed answer advances at once and is marked degraded, and further retries stop after the budget, which defaults to 2.
note.zh: 無法解析的回答會立刻放行並標成降級，重試在額度用完後停止，預設是 2 次。

caption.en: The orchestrator must return advance, retry, or abort as fenced JSON. If that JSON cannot be parsed, or a retry names no valid node, the stage advances immediately and the decision is marked degraded. Otherwise retry repeats the stage until maxRetriesPerStage, which defaults to 2, and the next retry advances as degraded. Abort still stops the run.
caption.zh: 協調者必須以圍起來的 JSON 回答 advance、retry 或 abort。JSON 無法解析，或 retry 沒有有效的節點時，階段會立刻放行，並把決策標成降級。否則 retry 會重複該階段，直到 maxRetriesPerStage（預設 2）用完，下一次就以降級放行。abort 仍然會停下這次執行。
